objective: Test a metadata fallback for artists without known relationships. Predict withheld source artist associations, with entire query artists removed from graph training. No recordings,lyrics or user histories.
artist_split: sha256(wiki-cold-artist-v1:+nativeURI) modulo5; all fold0artists lose every incident edge in both directions before degree,graphSVD or supervised fitting. All source identities and source metadata are known transductively.
metadata: Reuse independently replayed V6 canonical-genre,instrument,recordLabel TFIDF/L2 blocks from model-v5; no feature or weight changes. Reuse its64D unsupervised metadataSVD baseline.
new_model: 64D SVD of train-only binary neighbor profiles, rowL2normalized. Ridge regression from the fixed sparse metadata to normalized graph embeddings, alpha1, trained only on non-heldout artists with positive train degree and nonempty metadata. Solve normal equations using preconditionedCG, rtol1e-6,max500; reject nonconvergence. Predict heldout query embedding from metadata. Candidate graph vectors use observed train embeddings when nonzero,otherwise metadata predictions. Normalize predicted vectors before cosine.
queries: Every fold0artist with one or more full-source relationships and nonempty metadata. Record all ineligible identities and causes; no degree>=5 restriction.
gallery: All86253source identities excluding self,including artists without metadata or trained relationships. Missing vectors never remove positive instances from denominators.
ranking: Round scores8decimals,thenlexicalURI; recommend positive scores>1e-8 only, at most50. ReportMacroRecall10/50,MRR and numberofqueries returningpositivecandidates. Source neighbors are unknown for heldoutqueries and are not excluded as known relationships.
uncertainty: Paired query bootstrap1000 draws,seed20261024. Report95percentileintervals for Recall10 differences and complete degree/sourcegenre strata. These are descriptive cohort intervals,not listener-preference confidence.
acceptance: At least1000eligiblequeries and100percentpositivegallerycoverage. A new learned fallback must improve on both exact sparse metadata anddegree with a positive lower paired Recall10 difference interval; otherwise retain the simpler exact method only if it clearly beatsdegree. No new product inference without independent leakage/metric/source replay and clear metadata-inference labeling.
limits: Withheld source association recovery,not independent listener judgments,perceptual taxonomy,or EveryNoise parity. This is new-artist/unknown-graph generalization within known source metadata,not generalization to an unseen data source or fully unknown artist.
